card.statement:
[<<cite:E2>>,Proposition 3.5] Let $G \subset
\ZZ^n$ be such that $\{ t^m, m \in G\}$ is a set of coset
representatives for $A/A_{\psi}$. Let $v$ be a highest weight
vector in $V(\psi)$. Set $v(m) = v \otimes t^m$ for any $m\in
\ZZ^{n}$. Then

- $V (\psi) \otimes A = {\displaystyle{\bigoplus_{m \in G}}} U
v(m)$ where $Uv(m)$ is the $\widetilde{\gg}_A$-submodule
generated by $v(m)$.
- Each $U v(m)$ is an irreducible
$\widetilde{\gg}_A$-module.
- $U v(0) \cong
V(\overline{\psi})$ as $\widetilde{\gg}_A$-modules.
- All
components in (1) are isomorphic as $\widetilde{\gg}_A$-modules
up to a grade shift, that is the $D$ action is shifted by a vector
in $\CC^n$.
card.label: Proposition 1.2

paper.title: Representations of Loop Kac-Moody Lie Algebras
paper.abstract: We study representations of the Loop Kac-Moody Lie algebra g \otimes A, where g is any Kac-Moody algebra and A is a ring of Laurent polynomials in n commuting variables. In particular, we study representations with finite dimensional weight spaces and their graded versions. When we specialize g to be a finite dimensional or affine Lie algebra we obtain modules for toroidal Lie algebras.
